summary: Louisiana Forestry Commission tower in Ouachita Parish: 1971 survey describes a metal cabin on steel legs, a 1973 break-in is reported, and it is now listed as removed.

facts.design: Square silver metal observation cabin with windows on all sides, on four channel-steel legs (1971 survey description)
facts.status_note: Listed as removed, with no date; no source describes what, if anything, remains

notes_for_editor: Location conflict, not resolved: the 1973 report calls it the Luna Fire Tower in West Monroe; the 1971 survey places it 2.4 miles NNW of Luna (section 23, T16N R2E). The NGS text ties the 100 ft height to the observation cabin, so height_m 30.5 (already in the record) may be cabin height rather than overall height. No built date, staffing or fire history found. A Facebook post (Ouachita Parish, 1980s photo) was seen only as a search snippet, not on a readable page, and says an earlier wooden tower fell and was replaced by the metal one, numbered LA077. That is unverified and left out of the story; an editor could check it. Two web searches run.
